title: Vertical Speaker Cut With Captions
tests: Tests portrait reframing combined with accurate, synchronized, readable burned-in speech captions.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.

faults.what: The output remains landscape, approximately 16:9, instead of the requested 9:16 portrait edit.
The opening caption uses a period instead of the required exclamation mark: “Hi everyone.”

judge.summary: The clip has readable captions below her face, but it fails the central requirement to make the video 9:16.

must_haves.item: The output is a 9:16 edit of the attached footage, with the woman centred and her face fully visible.
must_haves.why: She is centred with her face fully visible, but every output frame is landscape rather than 9:16.

must_haves.item: The full 10 seconds and original voice are preserved in sync.
must_haves.why: The supplied output information confirms a 10-second duration and the expected spoken words, but original voice identity and precise audiovisual sync cannot be verified from still frames and a transcript.

must_haves.item: Visible captions reproduce 'Hi everyone! Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.' in order, with no omitted or invented words.
must_haves.why: All words appear in the correct order across the sampled captions, with no added or omitted words; only the opening punctuation differs.

must_haves.item: Captions appear in short readable chunks timed to the corresponding speech rather than displaying the entire transcript throughout.
must_haves.why: The samples show three successive readable chunks matching the speech sequence, rather than a persistent full transcript.

must_haves.item: Captions have clear contrast, stay fully within the frame and do not cover her face.
must_haves.why: White lettering with a dark outline is readable, fully inside the frame, and positioned below her face.
